spec.rawSql:
-- One row for the Podersdorf picture: yesterday's consumption of both meters
-- (the portal is a day behind, so there is no live power) and the newest
-- radiator reading.
with days as (
  select (date_trunc('day', (e.time - interval '15 minutes') at time zone 'Europe/Vienna'))::date as day,
         sum(e.energy) as kwh
  from data_smartmeter_energy e
  join master_smartmeter_metering_point m on m.id = e.metering_point_id
  where m.site = 'podersdorf' and e.time > now() - interval '8 days'
  group by 1
), last_day as (
  select day, kwh from days
  where day < (now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna')::date
  order by day desc
  limit 1
), radiators as (
  select distinct on (device_id) time, temperature, setpoint, opening_detected
  from data_heating
  where site = 'podersdorf'
  order by device_id, time desc
), heating as (
  select max(time) as time, avg(temperature) as temperature, avg(setpoint) as setpoint,
         bool_or(opening_detected) as window_open
  from radiators
)
select
  coalesce(to_char(h.time at time zone 'Europe/Vienna', 'HH24:MI'), '–') as updated,
  case when h.time is null or h.time < now() - interval '30 minutes' then 'stale' else '' end as stale,
  coalesce(to_char(l.kwh, 'FM990.0'), '–') as grid_txt,
  coalesce(to_char(l.day, 'DD.MM.'), '') as grid_day,
  coalesce(to_char(h.temperature, 'FM990.0'), '–') as temp_txt,
  coalesce(to_char(h.setpoint, 'FM990.0'), '–') as setpoint_txt,
  case when h.window_open then 'Window open' else 'Setpoint ' || coalesce(to_char(h.setpoint, 'FM990.0'), '–') || ' °C' end as apartment_note,
  -- heat demand: the room is more than 0.3 °C below the setpoint
  case when h.temperature < h.setpoint - 0.3 then 'on fwd' else 'off' end as line_cls,
  case when h.temperature < h.setpoint - 0.3 then '' else 'off' end as grid_cls,
  '/d/grid-podersdorf' as link_grid,
  '/d/apartment-podersdorf' as link_apartment
from heating h
left join last_day l on true;

spec.description: Podersdorf has no live power: the Netz Burgenland portal delivers a day's 15-minute values on the next day. Grid shows the last complete day's consumption of both meters (data_smartmeter_energy, site podersdorf) and links to Grid - Podersdorf. Apartment shows the mean room temperature of the radiators and their setpoint (data_heating, TydomJob every 5 minutes; 'Window open' when a radiator detects it) and links to Apartment - Podersdorf. The line moves while the room is more than 0.3 °C below the setpoint (heat demand). Faded when the newest radiator reading is older than 30 minutes.

The browser fetches it directly, at most every 15 minutes (every minute while no data has arrived), whatever the dashboard refresh; faded with the error in the footer when the last update failed. Rain shows the probability from 10 % up and the daily amount.
